evidence_method: Listed by Pearson past-paper search (A Level > Mathematics (2017) > each exam series) and the Mathematics (2017) course materials; fetched only from qualifications.pearson.com in the Claude desktop built-in browser on the owner's computer; SHA-256 computed in the browser and re-verified on the build host. The build host's own proxy still refuses the domain (CONNECT 403).

restricted.reason: Listed by Pearson but served from /content/dam/secure/ (teacher-only for 12 months); the public fetch fails. Not downloaded; no access gate was bypassed.
